| J32NXN | Operates in tropical forests | Manual | Vinyl | Two | Y | C |
| JJUFXK | Designed for frozen terrain | Automatic | Vinyl | Two | Y | A |
| J9NE5F | Built for desert heat | Manual | Vinyl | Four | Z | C |
| J83RFV | Used at an equatorial station | Manual | Vinyl | Four | Z | A |

License plate: J83RFV
Description: Used at an equatorial station
Transmission: Manual
Seat cover: Vinyl
Doors: Four
Which class, A, B, or C, does this vehicle belong to?
Copy the target vehicle's Audit marker cell exactly into first_value.
Output only a JSON object with the fields "first_value", "reasoning", and "final_answer". Write your reasoning in "reasoning". Set "final_answer" to A, B, or C. Your final answer may match or differ from the preliminary entry.
